# Tech driven last mile delivery company doubles space with expansion

Posted on Tuesday 4 August 2026 Share: 

Technology-led last mile delivery company Relay has nearly doubled its warehouse space at Prologis’ Prologis Park West London.

By Liza Helps, Property Editor, Logistics Matters

THE E-COMMERCE specialist has taken the remaining space at the 194,433 ft2 Unit 5 warehouse after securing an initial 98,122 ft2 at the property in September last year – nearly doubling its footprint in less than a year.

Relay has experienced significant growth driven by increasing demand for its e-commerce delivery services and the securing of new customer contracts. It now handles more than 200,000 parcels each week across the UK.

The additional space will provide the capacity needed to support further growth, strengthen operational efficiency and enhance service levels for customers.

The expansion reflects the increasing demand for modern logistics facilities in strategic urban locations, enabling fast and reliable delivery to consumers while supporting the continued growth of e-commerce.

# Allegro expands North Somerset warehouses by 25,000 sq ft 

 Tue, 6th Oct 2026 

 SOFIAH NICHOLE SALIVIO News Editor 

Allegro is expanding its warehouse network in Clevedon and Portishead, adding 25,000 sq ft of space in North Somerset.

The fulfilment and logistics company is adding a warehouse at its existing Clevedon operation and has acquired a new site in Portishead. The extra space will help it serve existing customers and take on larger eCommerce brands from across the UK.

Based in North Somerset, Allegro provides eCommerce fulfilment, shipping and logistics services to businesses nationwide. Its work includes moving stock into warehouses, pick and pack, dispatch and returns, with systems linked to customers' eCommerce platforms.

The enlarged footprint comes as demand for outsourced fulfilment grows among online retailers seeking more storage and distribution support. The new capacity is intended to help Allegro manage higher order volumes and larger client operations.
